critical_errors.issue: The cited CLD location arXiv:1204.6277v2, §3.1.3 does not define smooth (0,0)-forms or their local smooth-pullback description; it defines paralinéaire functions. The relevant ingredients occur instead in §§3.1.7 and 3.4.7. Wanner Definition 3.12 only defines smooth functions as A^{0,0}-sections, with the local tropical-chart description supplied by the preceding definitions. Thus the claimed exact external reference is mismatched.
